map.输入隧道断面积、设计控制风速与同时作业人数等参数，计算需风量、最低控制风速并给出: Enter tunnel cross-sectional area, design control velocity and number of workers to compute required airflow, minimum control velocity and fan-selection reference, for construction ventilation design.
map.按风速控制（velocity 模式）：需风量 Q=断面积 A×控制风速 v×36: Velocity control (velocity mode): required airflow Q=area A × control velocity v × 3600 (m³/h), and also Q÷3600 (m³/s); air changes per hour are estimated as v×3600÷100 (based on a 100 m tunnel section). The tool also gives a fan-selection reference: with 2 units in parallel, per-unit flow = Q÷3600÷2 (m³/s).
map.按 CO 稀释（CO 模式）：CO 排放总量=单车排放量 q×小时交通量 N×隧: CO dilution (CO mode): total CO emission = per-vehicle emission q × hourly traffic N × tunnel length L; required airflow Q=q×N×L÷δ (δ is the permissible CO concentration, entered directly as a ppm value); then back out the control velocity v=Q÷3600÷A and air changes n=v×3600÷L.
map.两模式互校与选型：先用风速法得到满足最低风速的风量，再用 CO 法校核稀释有害气: Cross-check the two modes and select: first get the airflow meeting the minimum velocity via the velocity method, then use the CO method to check dilution of harmful gases, taking the larger as the design airflow; fan selection uses the parallel unit count and an airflow margin (typically another 1.1~1.2 safety factor).
map.算例：60 m² 断面、控制风速 2.5 m/s 的风速法: Example: 60 m² section, control velocity 2.5 m/s (velocity method)
map.：风速模式输入 A=60 m²、v=2.5 m/s：需风量 Q=60×2.5×3: : velocity mode with A=60 m², v=2.5 m/s: required airflow Q=60×2.5×3600=540000 m³/h=150.00 m³/s; air changes=2.5×3600÷100=90.00 times/h; fan reference=75.00 m³/s per unit × 2 units. Another set A=80 m², v=2.0 m/s → Q=576000 m³/h=160.00 m³/s, air changes 72.00 times/h, 80.00 m³/s per unit.
map.CO 模式算出的风量为什么比风速法小很多，能直接用吗？: Why is the CO-mode airflow much smaller than the velocity method—can it be used directly?
map.不能直接用。工具的 CO 模式按 Q=q×N×L÷δ 直接代入数值计算：默认 q: No, not directly. The tool's CO mode computes Q=q×N×L÷δ by substituting numbers directly: with defaults q=0.02, N=800 vehicles/h, L=1000 m, δ=100 it outputs Q=160 m³/h (0.04 m³/s), v=0.001 m/s. Here L is entered in metres and δ as a ppm number, without converting to km and volume ratio (100 ppm=1×10⁻⁴) per engineering convention. By the standard form Q=q×N×L(km)÷δ(volume ratio), the same physical conditions give 0.02×800×1.0÷1e-4=160000 m³/h≈44.4 m³/s. So the CO-mode result is only a relative comparison within the same convention; for engineering calculations convert to standard units yourself and take the larger of the velocity method and the code limit.
map.换气次数里的 100 是什么意思？: What does the 100 in the air-changes figure mean?
map.工具按 v×3600÷100 估算每小时换气次数，即默认以 100 m 长的洞段: The tool estimates air changes per hour as v×3600÷100, i.e. it assumes a 100 m tunnel section (velocity times the distance travelled in an hour, divided by the 100 m length). If the actual ventilation zone length differs, convert it yourself as v×3600÷actual length, otherwise the air-change figure is systematically inflated or deflated.
